Generating 2,048 bit RSA key pair and self-signed certificate (SHA256withRSA) with a validity of 10,000 days
	for: CN=Android Debug, O=Android, C=US

-rw-r--r-- 1 root root 2666 Oct  9 12:40 /workspace/android/app/debug-keystore.jks

observation.command: export PATH=/usr/lib/jvm/java-17-openjdk-amd64/bin:$PATH; cd /workspace/android/app; keytool -genkeypair -v -keystore /workspace/android/app/debug-keystore.jks -storepass android -keypass android -alias androiddebugkey -keyalg RSA -keysize 2048 -validity 10000 -dname "CN=Android Debug,O=Android,C=US" >/tmp/keytool.log 2>&1; echo "exit=$?"; tail -3 /tmp/keytool.log; ls -la /workspace/android/app/debug-keystore.jks
